title: Big funerals: Celestin, Chris Kelly, Buddy Petit
summary: He missed playing Papa Celestin's and Chris Kelly's funerals and attended but did not play Buddy Petit's.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: What were some of the big funerals you've been to, you know where you played really big ones?

Oh I never played no good at big funerals. I had the opportunity to play at Papa Celestan Funerals but I was working at the time then you know. And I couldn't make it then. The General Chris Kelly Funerals was a big funeral too but we wasn't here at the time. We was in Greenville, Mississippi. The time Chris died, he had a big funeral up here.
Were you here for Buddy Petitia's funeral?
I was, yeah, yeah. But Buddy's funeral wasn't large as Chris would tell me. I was doing something like Papa Celestan.
No I didn't play this funeral.
